newsitem.title: USA: Applied Micro sees Q1 shr below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Applied Micro sees Q1 shr below estimates.

text.p: Applied Microsystems Corp said Friday that it expects earnings to be between a loss of $0.07 and a profit of nil, compared to $0.10 in the prior year's quarter and average analysts' expectations of $0.15.
Applied Micro said that it expects revenue for the first quarter to be between $8.5 million and $9.0 million, compared to $8.7 million in the prior year's qurater and to be below expectations.
The company said the lower revenue estimates reflect longer than anticipated quarter-ending sales cycles and unfavorable currency exchange rate fluctuations, especially with the Japanese Yen.
